failure_evidence.observed_failure: The original Style job ID matched; global restarted.jobs contained 2 jobs while the test expected 1.
failure_evidence.attribution: The same shard previously executed test_packaged_generation_fails_closed_without_text_provider, which persists and retains a record with that signature. Attribution is supported by source and execution order, but is not proven by ID because the failure representation truncates the extra record ID.

patch.explanation: JobManager restores all records returned by GenerationService.load_all. PostgreSQL queries the database-wide generation_jobs table; the File fixture uses a separate directory. Resetting the mounted manager jobs map does not clear PostgreSQL persistence. A global singleton expectation therefore does not express the no-replay requirement.
assertions: Snapshot every pre-existing persisted record and add a declared unrelated terminal fixture without calling its provider.
Require exactly the original Style job and the declared fixture as new persisted IDs; preserve every prior record.
Capture the completed Style receipt under its original terminal-publication condition and verify exact restored public state.
Require UNKNOWN_NO_AUTOMATIC_REPLAY and no model assessments after restart loses transient authorization.
Fail on any repeated author preparation or job start; require the original job ID on repeated dispatch.
Conserve the entire hydrated job map, persisted record map and original broker ledger after refresh and repeated dispatch.
patch.cleanup: The declared record belongs to the existing unique mounted project. Unchanged teardown removes only that owned project and its records; no pre-existing unrelated record is deleted.

validation.command_scope: Exact pytest arguments executed with the existing isolated Python interpreter through the isolated runner. Machine-specific interpreter path, runner location and log redirection are omitted from this publishable receipt.
